dailyHeadline: THANSKGIVING TURKEY DAY TERROR: Caaaam Stands Unbeaten at 11-0 While CerealStroke and OwenRiddell Fight for the Garbage Dumpster Championship!
dailySubhead: The Rhody Gridiron Desk serves up a feast of roasted managers on this fine November 26, 2026. Grab your turkey legs and watch Caaaam posture from his penthouse while ELord11 trades away his entire family tree.
tickerTape: BREAKING: Caaaam remains undefeated at 11-0 despite sitting a lazy 224.1 points on his bench!
TRADE WIRE: owenriddell and JewsInParis swap Jordan Love, DeVonta Smith, and Jordyn Tyson.
LIVE SCORES (Week 12): CarlaCote is up big on PrayingGrantis 54.7 to 28.22!
WAIVER MOVE: PrayingGrantis drops 19 FAAB on Chris Rodriguez Jr. because why save money in November?
STREAK WATCH: ELord11 is currently riding a depressing 6-game losing streak while drowning in trade notifications.
DUMPSTER FIRE ALERT: CerealStroke and owenriddell sit at the bottom of the league with 2 wins apiece.

roasts.headline: Caaaam's 11-0 Empire Built on Pure Luck and Veto Threats
roasts.body:
It sickens us to report this from the Kingston campus, but Caaaam is somehow 11-0 with 1,655.22 points. This is the same guy who blew 50 FAAB on a defense in Week 1 and spends his Tuesday nights writing newsletters about why everyone else's trades should be vetoed. Yet here he is, sitting atop the standings like a smug dean of students while leaving 224.1 points on his bench.

Meanwhile, down in the basement, CerealStroke and owenriddell are trying to start a fire with two damp matches and zero FAAB. CerealStroke hasn't touched the waiver wire all year and is somehow still winning games out of sheer accidental negligence. If Caaaam completes the undefeated regular season, we're renaming the Kingston campus quad after him—and none of us will ever hear the end of it.

roasts.headline: JewsInParis and owenriddell Pass Jordan Love Back and Forth Like a Hot Potato
roasts.body:
In what can only be described as a desperation swap between two managers trapped in the matrix, owenriddell and JewsInParis traded Jordan Love, DeVonta Smith, and Jordyn Tyson on November 25th. This comes shortly after JewsInParis infamously traded Drake London for Jordan Mason earlier this season—a transaction that will forever be studied in Kingston economics classes as a masterclass in getting fleeced.

JewsInParis is currently trying to claw out of a three-game losing skid at 7-4, while owenriddell is sitting at 2-9 wondering why his quarterback room looks like a revolving door at the Rhody Pub. At least JewsInParis picked up Brenton Strange off waivers to soothe the pain. Nothing screams 'championship pedigree' quite like picking up a tight end named Strange right before Thanksgiving.

roasts.headline: CarlaCote Serves Up a First-Half Thashing to PrayingGrantis
roasts.body:
Happy Thanksgiving, CarlaCote! While hiding out in witness protection, Carla is currently putting a clinic on PrayingGrantis, leading 54.7 to 28.22 in their Week 12 showdown. PrayingGrantis built a glowing superteam with 8 wins and 1,652 points, but right now, Carla's squad is making that superteam look like the 2004 URI Rhody basketball walk-ons.

PrayingGrantis even tried to buy a win by dropping 19 FAAB on Chris Rodriguez Jr. on waivers, but the fantasy gods aren't listening today. CarlaCote continues to sneak into victories from an undisclosed bunker somewhere outside Kingston, proving once again that you don't need to post in the league chat to ruin someone's holiday weekend.

roasts.headline: ELord11's Trade Addiction Reaches Terminal Velocity During 6-Game Skid
roasts.body:
ELord11 has officially lost six games in a row, dropping his record to 3-8, and how is he coping? By trading away half his roster and hoarding waiver claims like a raccoon in a dumpster behind Meade Stadium. Over the last few weeks, ELord11 has acquired Jameson Williams, Tucker Kraft, A.J. Brown, and traded away Trey McBride and Puka Nacua multiple times just to feel something.

He's down 51.7 to 31.5 against Tylero0 in Week 12, looking completely lost. Tylero0, never one to miss an opportunity to send a terrible fleece offer, is happily collecting wins while ELord11 stares blankly at his trade log trying to figure out if he can trade three backup wide receivers for a kicker. Get help, E-Lord. The therapy center is open on Route 1.

powerRankings.blurb: 11-0 with 1,655 points and a massive bench. Stop writing newsletters and start booking your championship rings.
Built a terrifying superteam, but currently getting smoked by CarlaCote. Time to panic.
8-3 and cruising, likely sending another garbage trade offer to an unsuspecting league mate right now.
Riding a three-game skid and still recovering from the legendary Drake London for Jordan Mason heist.
Sneaking out of witness protection long enough to dominate PrayingGrantis this week at 6-5.
Sitting at 5-6 after dropping Bryce Young and floundering in the mid-tier mud.
Six-game losing streak, 3-8 record, and a compulsive trade addiction that has completely ruined his roster.
Won two in a row, but allowed a league-worst 1,630 points against. Your defense is Swiss cheese.
8-game losing streak. Trading for Jordan Love won't save this Titanic of a season.
Ignored FAAB all season, leaves 227 points on the bench, and somehow has 2 wins. Absolute chaos.

tradeGrades.summary: owenriddell received Jordan Love & Jordyn Tyson; JewsInParis received DeVonta Smith
tradeGrades.verdict: JewsInParis needed a reliable wideout to stop the bleeding, while owenriddell continues his quest to collect every backup quarterback in the NFL database.

tradeGrades.summary: Tylero0 received Trey McBride; ELord11 received Jameson Williams & Tucker Kraft
tradeGrades.verdict: ELord11 couldn't resist trading away elite tight end Trey McBride because he has a medical condition requiring him to click 'Accept Trade' at least twice a week.

tradeGrades.summary: Shipoopiehole received Travis Kelce & Stefon Diggs; JewsInParis received Dalton Kincaid, Ladd McConkey & Jordyn Tyson
tradeGrades.verdict: Shipoopiehole went full win-now mode by grabbing aging star power, while JewsInParis collected spare parts like a guy parting out a Honda Civic in his driveway.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins & Blake Corum; PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden
tradeGrades.verdict: PrayingGrantis gave away Nico Collins for pennies in a baffling move, handing CarlaCote an absolute highway robbery while hiding from the FBI.
